title: Missing moeb tool: Read (large MCP result files)
description: Used Claude Code's external Read tool 5 times to access oversized MCP tool result files (mcp-moeb-start_run and mcp-moeb-grep_files outputs saved to .txt paths by the MCP result size limiter). No moeb equivalent exists for reading truncated MCP tool results. This caused a moeb-tool-origin rubric failure.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a kernel mechanism that handles oversized tool results inline (e.g., streaming, chunked read via read_file_range on the result file), eliminating the need for external file reads.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
